findings.issue: Dependencies claims «Живой PostgreSQL не нужен: ни один unit-тест фичи его не требует» (task-09:126), but the gate this task actually runs is `make test` = `go test -race -p 1 -timeout 300s ./...` (Makefile:33-36), and top/ already contains tests that open a real connection: top/top_test.go:10,19, top/signal_test.go:13,33,58,82, top/reload_test.go:19, top/reset_test.go:10, top/report_test.go:11 all call postgres.NewTestConnect(). The justification clause (the feature's own new unit tests need no PG) is true, but the unscoped headline is false for the whole-repo suite the AC demands, and a QA agent reading it literally may not provision the clusters and then mis-attribute connection failures to the feature.
findings.fix: Rewrite the bullet as: «Новым unit-тестам фичи живой PostgreSQL не нужен, но `make test` гоняет весь репозиторий, где top/top_test.go, signal_test.go, reload_test.go, reset_test.go, report_test.go используют postgres.NewTestConnect() — тестовые кластеры (порты 21914-21919) должны быть подняты до прогона». Add the clusters to the environment prerequisites next to Go 1.25+/golangci-lint/gosec/govulncheck.

findings.issue: The task treats `printCmdlinePersist` as a landed API of Task 5 and names it five times (Description, What-to-do step 4, Context Files, Details/Dependencies, the double-prefix trap). The name does exist in the tech-spec («What we're building/modifying») and in code-research §10.3 with the signature `printCmdlinePersist(g *gocui.Gui, format string, s ...any)`, so it is not invented — but task-05, the task that actually lands it, never names it: its step 4 only says «рядом появляется вариант, пишущий без таймера», and step 7 says «заменить прямую запись в буфер вьюхи cmdline (top/dialog.go:92) вызовом нового писателя». So the concrete identifier task 07 depends on is not fixed anywhere the implementer of task 5 is required to follow.
findings.fix: Either pin the name in task-05 step 4/7 (`printCmdlinePersist`, signature mirroring `printCmdline`), or keep task 07's already-present hedge as the only reference and phrase steps 4 and the AC as «писатель без таймера, приземлённый задачей 5 (в спеке — printCmdlinePersist)». The task's existing Context Files note («авторитет здесь у приземлённого кода») should be repeated at What-to-do step 4, where the name is used prescriptively.

findings.issue: Context Files cites «критерии приёмки блока „Диалоги“ (`:294-299`)» in the user-spec. The Диалоги block actually spans 015-feat-tui-papercuts.md:287-299 (header 287, five criteria at 288-291, 292-293, 294-296, 297-298, 299). The cited range starts mid-block and excludes the two criteria this task is primarily built around: alignment + prompt-truncation (288-291) and prompt/field on one line in verbose (292-293).

Step 20 and its AC turn on a ±1 row boundary (`-y 12` verbose ON vs `-y 11` fallback), but the geometry is asserted from the `tmux new-session -x/-y` arguments alone. Whether the pane the binary sees is exactly 12 rows depends on the tmux version's handling of `default-size`/status line for a detached session; a one-row discrepancy silently converts the boundary test into a test of the wrong threshold, and the failure looks like a task-01 defect.
findings.fix: After creating each session, record `tmux display -p -t cap '#{window_height} #{pane_height} #{pane_width}'` in the report artifacts and assert it equals the intended geometry before running the checks. Also prefer `tmux send-keys -t cap -l '\'` (literal flag) for the backslash and brackets in step 9/18, so a key-name lookup can never swallow the keypress.
